DNSquachWatch v1.8.1 updates the ST7789-80MHz classic 2.8-inch CYD build to SquachWatch base v1.35.0 while preserving DNSP's detection, labels, research, recovery, security, accessibility and menu organization.

This release adds smoother pet movement, character-placement fixes, Pocket Mode and dedicated BRIGHT MAX buttons. Later alerts can temporarily light a BOOT-darkened screen for the configured duration without cancelling Pocket Mode. Connection-only saved Wi-Fi, the signed GitHub updater, per-transmitter DEAUTH and DD:DD:DD simulation evidence remain.

DNSP currently targets classic 2.8-inch CYDs. Additional upstream boards and speaker/battery features are outside this release. WiGLE collection is deferred until a dependable GPS setup is supported; manual location labels are not GPS fixes.

Download the ST7789-80MHz kit below. Existing DNSP Content/v1.5 remains compatible. No ESP32 erase is needed. Display starts at 80MHz, flash remains 40MHz, and serial uses 115200 baud. ILI9341 receiver support has been removed. DNSP has never gifted ILI9341 receiver versions; those boards are now used for the separate simulation project. DNSP plans to gift only ST7789 units, selecting boards with both microUSB and USB-C ports.

Validation: ST7789 compilation, complete-image slot check, 55 native tests, 12 Python validation scripts and desktop UI checks passed. Physical hardware verification of these exact binaries remains pending.

Application image: 1,948,816 bytes; 17,264 bytes remain in the existing application slot.
